Issue Number 1, 2006 
 
IMMEDIATE PAST PRESIDENT’S 
MESSAGE  
 
 
 
Dear OPCC members, 
 
 My last five years as a member of 
OPCC have been very enjoyable and 
rewarding. 
 I have met many talented people and 
have made many friends, and have 
learned more about photography than I 
had hoped for. 
 
  
There have been a lot of changes in my 
life in the last two years, and I have 
decided to move from western 
Washington where I have lived all my 
life to Carlsbad, California.  I have some 
family in the area and had met a friend 
there last year.  She is a world traveler 
and an avid photographer.  But the 
Northwest will always be my "home". 
 
The travel bug is still with me having 
traveled to Europe, Africa, South 
America and Antarctica since we last 
met and with a few weeks in Southeast 
Asia scheduled for February. 
 
 I will send Jim my email address once I 
get settled so we can keep in contact. 
Thanks again for the friendships and I 
wish all of you a Great Christmas and 
all the best in the New Year. 
 
Bob Mandich 
________________________________________________________________________  
 
SENSOR DUST 
 
Bob Huelsdonk 
 
Last January, I submitted a digital projected competition 
print from my digital Canon D60 SLR which showed some 
wind generators against a plain blue sky.  Two of our 
discerning members, Jean Timmermeister and Valerie 
Henschel commented that the sky had a dim but 
noticeable dust spot on it.  I had not noticed it 
 on my computer screen or even on the projected 
image until it was pointed out.
